history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

munchkin-class.description: Munchkin start by class: today's product default for Warrior, Druid and Ranger (stair-scumming at depth 6), every other class ordinary. The arm that replaces implicit default in class grids. Names only borg_munchkin_by_class: for WDR classes the rule then forces the munchkin start itself, so borg_munchkin_start must stay unnamed (naming it FALSE contradicts the rule and reads as a config_error). Runs only on builds that know borg_munchkin_by_class (better-borg-c fd683ced and later).

4.2.6-bbc-m11.label: better-borg-c milestone 11 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v11): carries 116, up from 98. The v11 cycle adopts 17 new units (0100-0117, each a reviewed C-only source fix) plus the 0101a correction that gates the Lunal take skip on the runtime munchkin mode: stair escape ordering, per-monster flow-kill state, melee danger (armour divided by to-hit), pickup measured from the nearest up staircase, the no-rest-after-prep timer width, the preparedness reason copy, constitution-drain fear, Crush clearing ranged danger, the granite ranged test, Shoot'N'Scoot's adjacent monster, and the home/shop flows (empty pack slot, cure potions only when hurt, left ring search, swap and home-grab flags, staff charges, sold-item ego). Full matrix 95 groups / 290 cases, no failed group; 237/250 compared cases byte-identical, the 13 differences in six pre-existing fixture groups plus preparation (0105's timer width, identical decisions). No per-mode arm was measured in this cycle: each unit's per-mode effect is recorded as not measured, not neutral - the explicit-arms batch is the zoo's job (borg-zoo#54).

confirm-200.description: Confirmation suite: 200 fresh seeds never used before, 100,000 engine turns, fixed birth

experiment.description: Screening pass over the borg.txt switches that can change play, on v11 under the product class rule: dynamic calculations, enchant limit (5 and 20), town scumming, inventory swaps, risky play, chest risk and unique-waiting, against the plain munchkin-class arm. confirm-200 (200 fixed-birth seeds, 100,000 turns) - a rank ordering, not a result; the arms that move go to a full class grid.
experiment.name: switches-screen-v11
